//: Suggested permissions. riprap PRINTS this; it never applies it.
Widening an adopter's allowlist is a privilege grant, and merge-gates.md says
changes to .claude/settings.json need a human on them. riprap does not get to
exempt itself from its own rule, so this is a snippet to merge deliberately
into your .claude/settings.json — not something an installer writes for you.
Read permissions.md before trusting the deny list. Short version: these are
literal prefix matches, they stop mistakes rather than adversaries, and the
Artifact is the host's mockup tool, which design.md allows for mockups and for
showing the built result. This entry allows every Artifact action, not only a new
private publish: updating an existing page, including one already shared with
others, and reading pages other people own. The host still confirms deletes.
Merge it only if that scope is acceptable to you.
